of.text: Six hours of French courses chosen from French 325C, Crisis and Conflict; French 325D, Self and Society; and French 325E, Representing Difference. No more than six hours chosen from item 2 may be counted for the major. No more than three hours from item 2 may be counted for the major for students with credit for either French 326K, Introduction to French Literature I: From the Middle Ages through the Eighteenth Century; or French 326L, Introduction to French Literature II: From the French Revolution to the Present. Students with credit for French 326K and 326L may not count the courses in item 2 toward the major.
